name: HENTAI LABYRINTH
source:
You find yourself lost in a strange world and meet a girl bound in armor that... must be that older girl who used to live in your neighborhood? Sword in hand, join this girl on her journey of atonement and monster-bashing. Assist her, meet the strange inhabitants of the world, get caught up in everyone's affairs, and see where your journey takes you, and what mysteries might unfold before you.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Hentai_Labyrinth]AliceSoftWiki[/url]]
translation:
你迷失在一个陌生的世界，遇见了一名身着铠甲的少女。她……难道就是以前住在你家附近的那位大姐姐？拿起剑，与她一同踏上赎罪与讨伐怪物的旅途。帮助她，结识这个世界的奇异居民，卷入众人的纷争，看看旅程会将你引向何方，又会在你面前揭开什么谜团。

[摘自[url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Hentai_Labyrinth]AliceSoftWiki[/url]]
